title: The Dimming
subtitle: Something has gone quiet in the land of Zoe

intro.text: The land of Zoe was green, and its people sang while they worked. That was before the quiet came.
Sing? Oh, little ones. You have forgotten the words. And a song you cannot remember is not a song at all.
It tore five pages from the Great Book — the Five Power Verses — and scattered them across the kingdoms. Without them, fear spread like frost.
Not without them, Believer. Only lost. And what is lost can be restored by one willing to read aloud.

levels.title: A Light in the Square
levels.setting: The village square, first morning of the dimming

dialogue.text: You wake in the village square of Zoe. The market stalls stand open, but no one is trading.
The well is full, the fields are full… and still I'm afraid to draw the water. I can't explain it.
Are you the one Keeper Miriam said was coming? She says you carry a lamp that doesn't go out.
I do. And I say the dark ends where the Word is spoken. But the first page is torn right down the middle.
Believer — finish the verse our shepherds have sung for a thousand years. One word. Speak it, and let the light come back.

levels.mission: Restore the torn verse of the Shepherd.

puzzle.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not ____.
hints: It means 'to be in need of'.
The verse promises nothing is lacking.
puzzle.reveal: "The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want." When He leads, lack has no address.

levels.title: The Smith Who Stopped Hammering
levels.setting: Thomas's forge, cold for three days

dialogue.text: Don't mind the cold forge. I lit it yesterday and it felt like… like someone was watching the fire with me.
He is not imagining it, Believer. I sit beside every frightened man. It is comfortable here.
You are not welcome at this forge, Shadow. Thomas, what do you do when the iron comes out crooked?
…I put it back in the fire. You don't throw crooked iron away. You heat it and work it again.
Exactly. And what does the Word do to a crooked heart? Find the missing word and say it out loud.

levels.mission: Find the word that returns crooked things to the fire.

puzzle.verse: Thy word is a ____ unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
hints: You carry it in your hand, not on your back.
It shows the next single step — nothing more.
puzzle.reveal: "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet." Not a floodlight for the whole road. Just enough light for the next step.

levels.title: Words Scattered in the Dust
levels.setting: The road out of the square, where the page burned

dialogue.text: On the road out of the square, the torn page has burned down to scattered phrases.
I swept them into a pile this morning. Look — the promise is all tangled up.
Tangled is not destroyed. Believer, put the promise back in the order it was first spoken.
Four pieces out of order means many ways to be wrong. Give up, little lamp.
I counted them. There's only ONE right way. I like those odds!

levels.mission: Rebuild the scattered promise in its spoken order.

puzzle.prompt: Arrange the promise as it was first spoken.
hints: It begins with an instruction to the heart, not the mind.
The last words are what we must NOT lean on.
puzzle.reveal: "Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding." — Proverbs 3:5

levels.title: The Grid of Fear
levels.setting: The burned page, frozen into a lattice

dialogue.text: The Shadow has done something worse than tearing. It has woven the verse into a lattice of crossing words.
Across and down, Believer. Every word now holds up another word. Cut one and the whole thing remembers its shape.
Then we will read it the way it was written — across, and down. Take the clues and rebuild the lattice.
Like a forge joint. Nothing stands alone. Every piece carries its neighbour.
Beautifully said. Begin, Believer — and watch how one true letter makes the next one certain.

levels.mission: Rebuild the woven verse across and down.

clues.clue: "The LORD is my ____ and my salvation"
"The LORD is the ____ of my life"
"the LORD is the strength of my ____"

hints: LIGHT and LIFE share the L.
puzzle.reveal: "The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life." — Psalm 27:1

levels.title: Dread in the Square
levels.setting: The village square, midnight — the Shadow shows itself

dialogue.text: At midnight the Shadow steps out of the fog and stands in the middle of the square. It is taller than the chapel door.
You have recovered three words, Believer. Three. Do you know what I am? I am the thing you feel at 3am.
I am not beaten by courage. I am not beaten by effort. I am beaten only by a love you do not believe you have.
Then let us test that, Shadow. Believer — hide these words in your heart where the Shadow cannot reach them.
I'll help you look! Sara says if you find one, the rest get scared!
Find them. Find them, and I will simply wait for tomorrow.

levels.mission: Match the hidden word pairs before dread settles.

hints: Find each matching pair of words.
Remember where you saw each word.
puzzle.reveal: Faith, truth, peace, hope, love — five words the Shadow cannot hold. You have pushed it back to the edge of Zoe.
